description: This file defines the CurlFactoryInterface interface in the GuzzleHttp\Handler namespace, specifying methods for creating and releasing cURL handles for HTTP requests.

classes.name: CurlFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for creating and releasing cURL handles within Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cURL handle resource for the given HTTP request with specified options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases an easy handle, enabling it to be reused or closed.
